keywords: rsETH 跨链桥被攻击损失约 3 亿美元
koeppelmann 转向“安全优先于中立”
EIP-8037 SSTORE 恢复退款回滚语义
summary: 周日。koeppelmann 称 rsETH 跨链桥被攻击造成约 3 亿美元直接损失，并已让 Aave 市值蒸发超过 2 亿美元；他表示在自己能影响的系统中将默认“安全优先于中立”，支持暂停开关、每日限额等安全网。Vitalik 确认 eth.limo 问题已解决。

items.title: koeppelmann：rsETH 跨链桥被攻击，造成约 3 亿美元直接损失，总得有人承担；此外已让 Aave 市值蒸发超过 2 亿美元
items.title_en: koeppelmann: the rsETH bridge hack caused about $300 million in direct losses that someone will have to eat, and has already wiped out more than $200 million in Aave market cap

items.title: koeppelmann：虽然痛苦，但在自己能影响的系统中将默认“安全优先于中立”：“全部暂停”功能、每日限额、每笔交易都必须经过的额外安全层，都可以要
items.note: 19:52；bkiepuszewski：同意，前提是不默认交给一个能随时卷走所有人资金的中心化实体，而大多数协议恰恰如此 20:20。
items.title_en: koeppelmann: as much as it pains him, for things he has influence over he will switch to the default of security over neutrality: a "pause everything" function, a daily limit, an extra safety layer every transaction must pass
items.note_en: 19:52; bkiepuszewski: agrees, assuming that does not default to a centralized entity that can rug anyone, which is the case for most protocols, 20:20.

EIP-8037 SSTORE restoration refund rollback semantics
summary_en: A Sunday. koeppelmann said the rsETH bridge hack caused about $300 million in direct losses and had already wiped out more than $200 million of Aave market cap; for systems he can influence he will default to "security over neutrality", backing pause switches, daily limits and similar safety nets. Vitalik confirmed the eth.limo issue was resolved.
